anonymous_auth_enabled.title: API Server Anonymous Authentication Enabled
anonymous_auth_enabled.description: Whether the kube-apiserver is started with --anonymous-auth=true (or the flag is absent, which defaults to true), allowing unauthenticated requests to reach the API server and be processed under the system:anonymous identity.

etcd_client_cert_auth_enabled.title: etcd Client Certificate Authentication Enabled
etcd_client_cert_auth_enabled.description: Whether etcd requires mutual TLS client certificate authentication for all client connections (--client-cert-auth=true). When disabled, any network-accessible client can connect to etcd without authentication.

kubeconfig_privilege_level.title: Kubeconfig Privilege Level
kubeconfig_privilege_level.description: The highest privilege level granted by the stored kubeconfig credentials — cluster-admin, elevated (e.g., broad RBAC roles), namespace-scoped, or read-only.

kubeconfig_storage_locations.title: Kubeconfig Storage Locations
kubeconfig_storage_locations.description: List of locations where kubeconfig files are stored, such as CI/CD pipeline secrets, shared namespaces, developer workstations, or version control systems.

service_account_automounts_token.title: Service Account Token Auto-Mounted in Pods
service_account_automounts_token.description: Whether the service account has automountServiceAccountToken enabled (default true), meaning pods using this SA will automatically receive an API token that can be used to exercise the bound permissions.

short_lived_credential_rotation_enabled.title: Short-Lived Credential Rotation Enabled
short_lived_credential_rotation_enabled.description: Indicates whether the kubeconfig credentials use short-lived tokens (e.g., OIDC tokens with short TTL, projected service account tokens) that are automatically rotated, rather than long-lived static credentials.

workload_accessible_storage.title: Kubeconfig Accessible from Workload Zone
workload_accessible_storage.description: Indicates whether the kubeconfig is stored in a location reachable by workload-zone actors — e.g., a Kubernetes Secret in a non-isolated namespace, a CI/CD environment variable available to pipeline jobs, or a shared filesystem mount.

ingress_controller_automount_service_acc.title: Service Account Token Auto-Mounted in Ingress Controller Pod
ingress_controller_automount_service_acc.description: Indicates whether the ingress controller pod mounts the service account token automatically, making the token available to any process that achieves code execution inside the pod.

token_bound_to_audience.title: Service Account Token Bound to Specific Audience
token_bound_to_audience.description: Whether projected service account tokens with explicit audience and expiration are used instead of long-lived legacy tokens, limiting token reuse from external network locations.

binding_scope.title: Role Binding Scope
binding_scope.description: Whether the role binding is cluster-scoped (ClusterRoleBinding) or namespace-scoped (RoleBinding). Cluster-scoped bindings grant permissions across all namespaces.

bound_role_has_wildcard_or_admin.title: Bound Role Contains Wildcard Verbs or cluster-admin
bound_role_has_wildcard_or_admin.description: Whether the role referenced by the binding grants wildcard verbs, wildcard resources, or is the built-in cluster-admin ClusterRole, representing effectively unrestricted API access.

cross_namespace_rbac_bindings_present.title: Cross-Namespace RBAC Bindings Present
cross_namespace_rbac_bindings_present.description: Indicates whether ClusterRoleBindings or RoleBindings exist that grant service accounts in one tenant namespace access to resources in other tenant namespaces or cluster-wide control plane resources.

ingress_controller_cluster_scoped_secret.title: Ingress Controller Has Cluster-Scoped Secret Read Access
ingress_controller_cluster_scoped_secret.description: Indicates whether the ingress controller service account holds ClusterRole or ClusterRoleBinding permissions granting read access to Secrets across all namespaces, rather than being restricted to its own namespace.

ingress_controller_namespace_isolation_e.title: Ingress Controller Namespace Isolation Enforced
ingress_controller_namespace_isolation_e.description: Indicates whether the ingress controller RBAC permissions are scoped to its own namespace via RoleBindings rather than granted cluster-wide via ClusterRoleBindings.

kubelet_credential_host_path_mount_prese.title: Kubelet Credential Host Path Mount Present
kubelet_credential_host_path_mount_prese.description: Indicates whether any pod on the node mounts a host path that includes directories containing kubelet credentials (e.g., /var/lib/kubelet/pki or /etc/kubernetes/pki) allowing workload access to node certificates.

node_certificate_file_permissions_world_.title: Node Certificate Files World Readable
node_certificate_file_permissions_world_.description: Indicates whether the kubelet client certificate and key files on the node filesystem have overly permissive file permissions (readable by non-root users).

node_restriction_admission_plugin_enable.title: NodeRestriction Admission Plugin Enabled
node_restriction_admission_plugin_enable.description: Indicates whether the NodeRestriction admission controller is enabled on the API server, which limits what resources a node identity can access or modify, reducing the blast radius of node credential reuse.

subject_type.title: Binding Subject Type
subject_type.description: The kind of subject referenced in the role binding. ServiceAccount subjects attached to pods create direct workload-to-control-plane privilege propagation paths.

webhook_operator_rbac_unrestricted.title: Webhook Operator Has Unrestricted RBAC
webhook_operator_rbac_unrestricted.description: Indicates whether the service account or identity operating the webhook server has cluster-admin or equivalent RBAC permissions, meaning a compromised webhook operator can also directly manipulate cluster state.

api_server_firewall_ingress_restricted.title: External Firewall/Security Group Restricts API Server Ingress
api_server_firewall_ingress_restricted.description: Whether a host-level firewall, cloud security group, or ACL restricts inbound access to the API server port (6443/443) to only authorized CIDR ranges. False means the port is reachable from workload subnets or the public internet.

cni_plugin_enforces_networkpolicy_in_con.title: CNI Plugin Enforces NetworkPolicy in Control Plane Namespace
cni_plugin_enforces_networkpolicy_in_con.description: Whether the installed CNI plugin is capable of and configured to enforce NetworkPolicy for pods running in the control plane namespace.

control_plane_components_run_as_static_p.title: Control Plane Components Run as Static Pods Outside CNI Scope
control_plane_components_run_as_static_p.description: Whether control plane components run as static pods whose network namespace may bypass CNI-enforced NetworkPolicy, making any configured NetworkPolicy ineffective for them.

control_plane_namespace_egress_networkpo.title: Control Plane Namespace Egress NetworkPolicy Configured
control_plane_namespace_egress_networkpo.description: Whether NetworkPolicy resources with egress rules exist in the namespace(s) hosting control plane components, restricting outbound traffic from API server, controller-manager, and scheduler pods.

default_network_policy_present.title: Default Deny NetworkPolicy Present
default_network_policy_present.description: Indicates whether a default-deny NetworkPolicy exists in each tenant namespace to restrict cross-namespace traffic by default.

egress_network_policy_controls_control_p.title: Egress Network Policy Restricts Control Plane Ports
egress_network_policy_controls_control_p.description: Whether NetworkPolicy objects exist in workload namespaces that explicitly restrict egress traffic on ports 443 and 6443 toward control plane IP ranges, preventing unrestricted token-bearing connections from compromised pods.

etcd_listen_address_scope.title: etcd Listen Address Scope
etcd_listen_address_scope.description: The network scope on which etcd client port binds. loopback_only means 127.0.0.1 only; node_local means bound to node's primary interface; all_interfaces means 0.0.0.0, accessible from any network interface.

etcd_network_access_restricted_to_api_se.title: etcd Network Access Restricted to API Server Only
etcd_network_access_restricted_to_api_se.description: Whether network-level controls enforce that only the API server can reach etcd client ports (typically 2379/2380). False means etcd is reachable from broader cluster network or nodes.

network_policy_restricts_api_server_egre.title: Network Policy Restricts Pod-to-API-Server Egress
network_policy_restricts_api_server_egre.description: Whether NetworkPolicy resources exist in workload namespaces that explicitly deny or restrict pod-initiated connections to the API server port. False means no such policy is enforced and pods can freely initiate connections to the control plane.

webhook_server_zone.title: Webhook Server Network Zone
webhook_server_zone.description: The network zone where the admission webhook server is deployed, indicating whether it resides in the workload zone (operator-controlled), shared zone, or a dedicated control plane zone.

ingress_controller_exposed_to_external_t.title: Ingress Controller Directly Exposed to External Traffic
ingress_controller_exposed_to_external_t.description: Indicates whether the ingress controller receives traffic directly from outside the cluster (e.g., via LoadBalancer or NodePort service type), placing it in an externally reachable attack position.

high_risk_api_groups_covered.title: High-Risk API Groups Covered by Webhooks
high_risk_api_groups_covered.description: Indicates whether admission webhooks include rules covering high-risk API groups such as apps, batch, and the core group ('') for all relevant resource types. False means privileged workload creation paths are uninspected.

webhook_ca_bundle_configured.title: Webhook CA Bundle Configured
webhook_ca_bundle_configured.description: Indicates whether a caBundle is explicitly set in the webhook configuration, enabling the API server to verify the TLS identity of the webhook server.

webhook_covered_operations.title: Webhook Covered Operations
webhook_covered_operations.description: List of HTTP operations (CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE, CONNECT) covered by the admission webhook rules across all registered webhooks. Gaps indicate policy bypass surfaces.

webhook_covered_subresources.title: Webhook Covered Subresources
webhook_covered_subresources.description: List of subresources explicitly covered by admission webhook rules (e.g., pods/exec, pods/ephemeralcontainers, pods/attach). Absence of high-risk subresources indicates bypass gaps.

webhook_namespace_selector_present.title: Webhook Namespace Selector Restricts Scope
webhook_namespace_selector_present.description: Indicates whether any registered admission webhook uses a restrictive namespaceSelector that excludes one or more non-system namespaces from policy inspection, creating namespace-scoped bypass gaps. Also used to assess whether all webhooks have scoped selectors for multi-tenant enforcement.

webhook_failure_policy.title: Webhook Failure Policy
webhook_failure_policy.description: The failurePolicy setting for registered admission webhooks. Ignore means a webhook timeout or error allows the request through, compounding scope gap and trust inversion risks.

audit_log_backend_enabled.title: Audit Log Backend Enabled
audit_log_backend_enabled.description: Whether at least one audit log backend (file or webhook) is configured and active on the API server.

audit_policy_configured.title: Audit Policy Configured
audit_policy_configured.description: Whether the API server has an audit policy file configured (--audit-policy-file flag is set and points to a valid file).

audit_policy_sensitive_verb_coverage.title: Audit Policy Sensitive Verb Coverage
audit_policy_sensitive_verb_coverage.description: Whether the audit policy includes RequestResponse level logging for sensitive verbs (get on secrets, exec, bind, escalate) across relevant API groups.
